# Dar Saha

A self-initiated, fictional portfolio concept by Digits Studio. No affiliation with an operating business is claimed. Names, products, prices and commercial stories are illustrative. Reference photography is licensed and credited in the project photography credits; original brand applications are vector illustrations. Campaigns are proposed creative, not reported performance. No client testimonials, awards or certifications are represented.

Deliverables: original outlined bilingual SVG logos and symbol, brand board, packaging label, concept business cards with a working case-study QR, 3 portrait posts, 2 Arabic stories, 1 landscape ad, PNG exports, bilingual captions, a four-week campaign plan, welcome-email preview and a functional website demo. The stay planner and class-selection demos work locally and do not create reservations, memberships or payments.

Website: https://digitsstudio.online/demos/dar-saha/
Case study: https://digitsstudio.online/projects/dar-saha/

Fonts: Archivo, Instrument Sans, IBM Plex Sans Arabic, and Fraunces, supplied under SIL OFL. SVG text is outlined; colours and paths are editable. Print artwork is a concept, not a printer-certified production file. Editable copy and artwork generators are included in the project source.
